# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 15 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-14 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level14_widening.rs) to level 15 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-14
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-15 "Special" column reads
# "Inspire competence +5, inspire heroics" (verified independently against
# d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both byte-for-byte
# identical), so no new choice line is required: Inspire Competence's
# magnitude rise is grounded via the existing tiered-magnitude idiom (no new
# choice slot), and Inspire Heroics is a wholly new 15th-level class feature
# grounded only as flat, non-level-scaled magnitude constants (a +4 morale
# bonus on saves, a +4 dodge bonus to AC, and a base 1-target count), no
# choice slot required.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion execution, no Dirge of Doom execution,
# no Inspire Greatness execution, no untrained-skill-use execution for
# Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master take-10/take-20 execution against any
# actual Knowledge check, no Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal
# execution, no Frightening Tune fear-resolution execution, no Inspire
# Heroics targeting/save/AC-application execution, and no spontaneous
# known-spell / slot posture burden. Base attack bonus and poor Fortitude
# genuinely rise from level 14 (15*3/4=11, 15/3=5), both good saves
# (Reflex, Will) stay unchanged (15/2+2=9, an integer-division coincidence
# with level 14), Bardic Knowledge stays unchanged (max(15/2,1)=7, a
# coincidence), the Bardic Performance rounds-per-day pool genuinely rises
# (4+CHA+2*(15-1)=34), and the Fascinate DC/affected-creature-count both
# stay unchanged (10+15/2+CHA=19, 1+(15-1)/3=5, both integer-division
# coincidences with level 14).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level15
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:15
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
